intro: Woodland Hills sits at the west end of the Valley, with Ventura Boulevard's restaurants along the south side, the Warner Center district's parks and shopping to the north, and the Santa Monica Mountains rising behind it.

gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)

places.w: A small, ambitious neighborhood restaurant with a seasonal menu, a tasting menu option and weekend brunch.
places.o: The four-course tasting menu, or happy hour at the bar.

places.w: A lively, high-end sushi restaurant with fish sourced from Japan, in an unassuming building.
places.o: Start with the omakase; come back for the loaded chirashi at lunch.

places.w: A big gastropub with a patio, a strong happy hour and a packed room on game days.
places.o: Fish and chips and the lemon-pepper wings during the game.

places.w: An open-air shopping village with restaurants, a bookstore and plenty of outdoor seating.
places.o: Browse The Open Book, then grab lunch on the plaza.

places.w: A big, shady lawn that hosts free concerts in the summer.
places.o: Bring a blanket for a summer concert night.
